Welcome to the WordCamp Europe press page! Below you will find all relevant information, resources, and materials to help you cover WordCamp Europe 2026.

## Press Contact

Please <a href="https://europe.wordcamp.org/2026/contact/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener"><strong>contact us</strong></a> for any press inquiries, or if you would like to be included on our media mailing list in order to receive announcements and the latest news.

Our friendly PR team will get back to you as soon as possible.

## Press Kit

You can **download our Press Kit** to access media assets including logos, graphics to support weekly press releases, and badges.

Also check our captivating photos of previous events on our [WordCamp Europe Flickr albums](https://www.flickr.com/photos/wceu/albums). You are free to use them, and edit them – But must attribute to WordCamp Europe and share any edits for others to freely use.

## Organisers

WordCamp Europe is organised by a team of volunteers from different countries. The team changes each year depending on location, with a new local team added to the original team of organisers.

[Here is a full list of the WordCamp Europe 2026 organisers](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2026/community/organisers/).

## About WordCamp Europe

WordCamp Europe (WCEU) is the largest WordPress conference in the world.

This annual event welcomes all WordPress enthusiasts and aims to strengthen connections between the growing European communities that support and contribute to the open-source project.

WordCamp Europe includes two conference days and a separate Contributor day, where people from all around the world gather to share knowledge, connect, and contribute back to the WordPress project.

Hosted by a different European city each year, WordCamp Europe is organised by volunteers from the WordPress community. <a href="https://icekrakow.pl/en" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">ICE Kraków Congress Centre</a>, with world-class infrastructure, exceptional accessibility, and inspiring views of Wawel Castle and the Vistula River, offers the perfect setting for our community to learn, connect, and create together at WordCamp Europe 2026.

The location of WordCamp Europe 2027 will be announced during the closing remarks in Kraków.

- [WordCamp Europe 2025](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2025/) in Basel, Switzerland
- [WordCamp Europe 2024](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2024) in Turin, Italy
- [WordCamp Europe 2023](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2023/) in Athens, Greece
- [WordCamp Europe 2022](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2022/) in Porto, Portugal
- [WordCamp Europe 2021](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2021/) online
- [WordCamp Europe 2020](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2020/) online
- [WordCamp Europe 2019](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2019/) in Berlin, Germany
- [WordCamp Europe 2018](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2018/) in Belgrade, Serbia
- [WordCamp Europe 2017](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2017/) in Paris, France
- [WordCamp Europe 2016](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2016/) in Vienna, Austria
- [WordCamp Europe 2015](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2015/) in Seville, Spain
- [WordCamp Europe 2014](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2014/) in Sofia, Bulgaria
- [WordCamp Europe 2013](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2013/) in Leiden, The Netherlands
